title: Products with a high refund rate
prompt: Using the product_sales13 table (one row per sale, with a refunded column that is 1 if the sale was refunded and 0 otherwise), return each product along with its refund rate (the fraction of its sales that were refunded) as a column named refund_rate, but only include products where the refund rate is greater than 0.3.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE product_sales13 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product TEXT, amount INTEGER, refunded INTEGER); INSERT INTO product_sales13 VALUES (1,'Widget',10,0),(2,'Widget',10,0),(3,'Widget',10,1),(4,'Widget',10,1),(5,'Gadget',20,0),(6,'Gadget',20,0),(7,'Gadget',20,0),(8,'Gadget',20,1),(9,'Gizmo',5,1),(10,'Gizmo',5,1);
reference_sql: SELECT product, CAST(SUM(refunded) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) AS refund_rate FROM product_sales13 GROUP BY product HAVING CAST(SUM(refunded) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) > 0.3;
